Name: Custom Backpack Framework for Yuzu Chest
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[font=Courier New][b][color=#e06666][size=5]Custom Backpack Framework for Yuzu Chest[/size][/color]
[size=4]A compatibility build of Custom Backpack Framework for large backpacks, vanilla chests, and Yuzu Chest.[/size]
[size=4]Use it with Pack and Backpack Collection or other compatible content packs to expand your backpack. Available sizes depend on the content pack you install, including options from 48 up to 1,008 slots.[/size][/b][/font]

[font=Courier New][b]
[color=#e06666][size=5]Features[/size][/color]
[size=4]• Supports vanilla chests and Yuzu Chest.[/size]
[size=4]• Keeps your current backpack row after transferring items.[/size]
[size=4]• Preserves your backpack scroll position when switching chests with Chests Anywhere.[/size]
[size=4]• Preserves Yuzu Chest’s custom backpack layout while scrolling.[/size]
[size=4]• Includes compatibility adjustments for Automate, Chests Anywhere, and Better Sort.[/size]
[size=4]• Supports existing Custom Backpack Framework content packs.[/size][/b][/font]

[font=Courier New][b]
[color=#e06666][size=5]What’s New in 2.0.0[/size][/color]
[size=4]• Adds safeguards to reduce unwanted cursor snapping while using the mouse in chest menus.[/size]
[size=4]• Keeps explicit keyboard and controller navigation available.[/size]
[size=4]• Retains the existing backpack scrolling and Yuzu Chest layout fixes.[/size]
[size=4]The build and automated checks have passed. Full in-game verification of the cursor changes is still pending.[/size][/b][/font]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#e06666][size=5]Important[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#ff0000]Do not install this alongside the original Custom Backpack Framework. [/color]This build replaces it and uses the same Unique ID so existing content packs can continue to work.[/size]
[size=4]The separate fix that preserves cursor position when switching chests with Chests Anywhere is included in the updated Yuzu Chest mod. Update Yuzu Chest as well to receive that fix; Framework 2.0.0 alone does not include it.[/size]
[size=4]Other custom or oversized chest menus are not officially supported. Compatibility with every mod combination is not guaranteed.[/size][/b][/font]

[font=Courier New][b]

[size=4]• Stardew Valley 1.6 port: platinummyr[/size]
[size=4]• Yuzu Chest compatibility fixes: Yuzu[/size]
